plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked attenuation-drop chart from Kao & Hockham (1966) and Corning (1970–1979) shows 1960s optical glass (1,000 dB/km loss — 99% lost in 20 m) vs Charles Kao's 1966 target threshold (20 dB/km — 1% surviving 1,000 m), Corning's August 1970 titanium-doped silica fibre (17 dB/km), and modern 1,550 nm silica fibre (0.2 dB/km — >95% surviving 1 km).
